title: Recipes Creator

body:
# RecipesCreator 
## ⚠️ ModMenu 17.0.0 is strongly recommended for a smoother use ⚠️

RecipesCreator is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that lets you create and manage custom crafting recipes directly in-game. You can add both shaped and shapeless recipes, choose nearly any vanilla or modded item as an ingredient or result, and enable or disable recipes whenever you want through a simple configuration interface.

The mod also includes a set of built-in recipes for rare items that are normally difficult or impossible to craft. These built-in recipes can be toggled individually, so you can decide which ones fit your world or server. The current built-in recipes include Elytra, Totem of Undying, Enchanted Golden Apple, Bottle o' Enchanting, and Heavy Core.

RecipesCreator is designed for players and modpack creators who want more control over progression, accessibility, and gameplay balance without editing data packs by hand. It also integrates with ModMenu for easy access and includes a welcome screen to help first-time users get started quickly.

## Features

- Create custom shaped recipes
- Create custom shapeless recipes
- Enable or disable custom recipes at any time
- Use vanilla and modded items in recipes
- Toggle built-in rare item recipes individually
- Configure everything from an in-game screen
- ModMenu integration
- First-launch welcome screen

## Built-in Recipes

- Elytra
- Totem of Undying
- Enchanted Golden Apple
- Bottle o' Enchanting
- Heavy Core

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Java 21
